title: 第七章 神念引发的猜测第八章 炎刹
lines: 雷涅手指一挥，操控着第二躯体“叶不休”往身旁站定。其犹如最忠心的守卫将雷涅给保护了起来。
雷涅点了点头。
随即开始悬气闭目，调息打坐。
经过此番种种，雷涅对于自己的身体是否因此而出现变故，一直心有余悸。
如今好不容易回归正常，并有了可以探查体内情况的机会。
雷涅自然是马不停蹄的，用回归的神念扫过自己的身体各处。
每一处都极为细致的探查着，不漏掉任何可疑之处。
而就是在雷涅这般仔细的探寻下，雷涅也着实发现了一处蹊跷的地方。
不是玄气，不是肉身。
而是正在探查身体的神念！
雷涅能清楚的感觉到，神念的回归让雷涅对于周围环境的感知比起之前丧失神念的状态强上了数个层次，但一开始，雷涅也只是将此等神念强度视为，普通真丹境凝成神念该有的强度。
可伴随着雷涅，不断用神念扫视自己的身躯，其竟惊奇的发现。
自己运用神念对自己的肌肉，骨骼，甚至丹田处玄气的观察与掌控，竟达到了一种极为恐怖的超然层次。
这种超然之感让雷涅有自信，凭借自己现在的实力可以轻松的，面对两名同级修士而不落下风，甚至若将现在的一缕神念参进自身的玄气中，以此种玄气做为偷袭手段，雷涅可以笃定有九成的把握将同级修士轻松击杀。
但也就是这种超然之感，让雷涅有些恍惚。
要知道修士踏入真丹境，所凝炼的真丹与神念本源，本就是看自身有多少玄气可以用来压缩凝炼之用，以此定下真丹与神念本源的品质。
自己的修炼天赋本是属于开启了二百三十个位点的中下层次，能踏入到真丹境已经属于莫大造化了，凭自己二百三十个位点吸纳进体的玄气浓度，想要压缩出此等神念本源是绝迹不可能的事！
但现在其却是真真实实的发生了！
“凭自己区区二百三十个位点又怎会凝炼出如此深厚的神念？！”
“难道还是跟那些黑色神念有关？！”
雷涅嘴中呢喃出声，语气中不禁带着疑惑之意。
缓缓睁眼，转头望向一旁的第二躯体。
准确的说是存在于其体内的那些黑色神念。
而这回，雷涅盯着这些黑色神念的目光中，除了以往有的忌惮与愤恨外，如今还多出了另外一种情绪。
说不上是欣喜还是惊异。
只能说，雷涅对于这些黑色神念又生出了一种极其复杂的感觉，而这种感觉稍偏正向。
想来自己凝炼而出的神念本源与意识一同回归本体后，应该是带出了少许的黑色神念，一并窜回体内，这才导致，如今的神念本源达到了雷涅正常凝炼的情况下，所不能触及的高度。
这种情况的出现，从某种的意义上讲，间接让雷涅推衍出，隐藏在此事上的另一真相！
便是……
自己的神念本源与这些黑色神念的融汇程度，即使利用那玄傀室魂阵之力将之分离，也没有彻底切断二者的联系！
最终还是有这么一缕黑色神念与自己的神念本源融为一体。
也许之所以能发生，自己的意识穿梭到第二躯体这种玄之又玄的情况。
多半还是跟这个两者融合后的新神念有关！
“意识是与这新神念一起回归本体的，难道说……”
“先前是这股新神念携带着自己的意识穿梭回本体的？！”
雷涅之所以会生出如此想法，一个主要原因在于，那些黑色神念在雷涅心目种可是颇为的神秘强大，他断然不会单纯的以为，能将自己几次逼入绝地的黑色神念只拥有普通的神念之力，其必然还拥有其它的非凡特性！
所以此时处于本体内的新生神念，必然也继承了其所具备的非凡特性！
“神念承载意识”必定是这些非凡特性的其中之一！
content_en:
Rene waved his finger and controlled the second body "Ye Buxiu" to stand beside him. He protected Rene like the most loyal guard.
Rene nodded.
Then he began to meditate with his breath closed, his eyes closed, and his breath adjusted.
After all these events, Rene had lingering fears about whether his body would undergo any changes.
Now I have finally returned to normal, and I have the opportunity to explore the situation inside my body.
Rene naturally kept going non-stop, scanning every part of his body with his returning spiritual thoughts.
Everywhere was explored with great detail, not missing anything suspicious.
And even with Rene's careful exploration, Rene actually discovered something strange.
Not the mysterious energy, not the physical body.
Rather, it is the divine mind that is probing the body!
Reine could clearly feel that the return of spiritual thoughts made Reine's perception of the surrounding environment several levels stronger than when he had lost his spiritual thoughts before. However, at the beginning, Reine only regarded the strength of such spiritual thoughts as the intensity that ordinary true elixir realm condensed divine thoughts should have.
But as Rene kept scanning his body with his spiritual thoughts, he was surprised to find something.
He used his spiritual thoughts to observe and control his muscles, bones, and even the profound energy in his Dantian, reaching an extremely terrifying level of transcendence.
This sense of transcendence makes Reine confident that with his current strength, he can easily face two monks of the same level without falling behind. Even if he incorporates his current spiritual thoughts into his own profound energy and uses this mysterious energy as a sneak attack method, Reine can be sure that he will easily kill the monks of the same level with a 90% certainty.
But it was this sense of detachment that made Rene feel a little dazed.
You must know that when a monk enters the true elixir realm, the true elixir and the source of his spiritual thoughts that he condenses are based on how much profound energy he has that can be used for compression and condensation, so as to determine the quality of the true elixir and the source of his spiritual thoughts.
My cultivation talent belongs to the middle and lower levels with 230 points opened. It is a great blessing to be able to step into the true elixir realm. With the concentration of profound energy absorbed into the body by my 230 points, it is impossible to compress the source of such spiritual thoughts!
But now it is really happening!
"How can I condense such profound spiritual thoughts with just 230 points?!"
"Is it still related to those black divine thoughts?!"
Rene murmured, with doubts in his tone.
He slowly opened his eyes and turned his head to look at the second body beside him.
To be precise, it is the black divine thoughts that exist in his body.
But this time, in addition to the fear and resentment that he had in the past, there was another emotion in Rene's gaze as he stared at these black divine thoughts.
Can't tell whether it was joy or surprise.
It can only be said that Rene had an extremely complicated feeling about these black divine thoughts, and this feeling was slightly positive.
I think that after the source of the divine thought that I condensed returned to the body together with the consciousness, it should have brought out a little black divine thought and rushed back into the body. This resulted in the current source of the divine thought reaching a height that Rene's normal condensation could not reach.
The emergence of this situation, in a sense, indirectly allowed Rene to deduce another truth hidden in this matter!
That’s it…
The origin of my own spiritual thoughts is so integrated with these black divine thoughts that even if I use the power of the Xuanpuppet Chamber Soul Formation to separate them, the connection between the two has not been completely severed!
In the end, there was still such a ray of black divine thought that merged with the origin of his own divine thought.
Perhaps the reason why it can happen is that my consciousness travels to the second body, which is a mysterious and mysterious situation.
Mostly it has something to do with the new divine thought after the fusion of the two!
"Consciousness returns to the original body together with this new divine thought. Could it be said that..."
"Did this new spiritual thought carry my consciousness back to my body before?!"
One of the main reasons why Reine had such an idea was that those black divine thoughts were quite mysterious and powerful in Renie's mind. He would definitely not simply think that the black divine thoughts that could force him into despair several times only had the power of ordinary divine thoughts, and they must have other extraordinary characteristics!
Therefore, the new divine mind in the body at this time must also inherit its extraordinary characteristics!
"Divine thoughts carrying consciousness" must be one of these extraordinary characteristics!
